Form a sparse Nearest-Neighbor Gaussian Process Precision Matrix. See https://mc-stan.org/users/documentation/case-studies/nngp.html.

nngp_prec_mat.Rd

Form a sparse Nearest-Neighbor Gaussian Process Precision Matrix. See https://mc-stan.org/users/documentation/case-studies/nngp.html.

Usage

nngp_prec_mat(sp_dist, coords, cov_type, cov_params)

Arguments

sp_dist

Output of sparseDist_LT function. Basically, top few rows are nearest distances, bottom few rows are indices. CALL THAT FUNCTION OR SEE IT FOR MORE DETAILS.

coords

Matrix (x, y) of coordinates.

cov_type

String for covariance model type. "Exp", "Sph", "Gau", and "Mat" are supported.

cov_params

Covariance/kernel parameters. Same order as in variogram functions. Nugget variance (partial sill), Spatial variance (partial sill), Spatial range (scales distance); if Matern, smoothness kappa.

Value

A list with a sparse precision matrix and associated eigenvalues.

Sparse precision matrix Q.

Eigenvalues Dinv.

Lower triangular factor A.

Note

Applies to a single area.

Requires the Matrix library.

Author

Florica J Constantine, florica AT berkeley.edu
